rows.name: Switch to AT&T Business, $800 Per Line

callReview.totalNote: total of 73,606 calls from Jan 1 to Jan 31

calls.summary: Marcus Delgado called to modernize his 6 site network and asked about AT&T SD-WAN pricing and performance. Oscar walked through per-site options and booked a consultation with a networking specialist for the following week. Marcus confirmed the appointment and shared his IT contact details.

Priya Nathan inquired about AT&T Business Fiber for a new office location and wanted symmetrical speeds with unlimited data. Lila confirmed serviceability at the address and scheduled a consultation to finalize the plan. Priya was pleased with the $40 starting rate.

Dennis ORourke wanted to move his team to Business Unlimited Advanced with 4 lines and asked about hotspot data. Rosey explained the 100GB per line allowance and set up a consultation to review device upgrades. Dennis agreed to the follow up.

Angela Foster called as a new customer to set up SIP trunking for her growing call center and needed IP Flexible Reach connected to her IP-PBX. Lee collected her business name, location, channel count, and billing contact, then scheduled a consultation with a voice specialist. Angela confirmed her details and the appointment time.

Robert Chan asked how the AT&T International Day Pass for Business works before a trip to Germany. Mary confirmed the roughly $10 per day rate and explained his domestic plan would apply abroad. Robert was checking an existing setup and did not need a new appointment.

Teresa Blanco called about a delayed Business Fiber installation at her retail store that missed the scheduled window. Sue apologized, located the work order, and escalated to dispatch for a firm reschedule. Teresa remained frustrated but accepted the new date.

Victor Mendez disputed a charge on his Business Unlimited Standard account after being billed for extra lines he did not add. Mike reviewed the invoice and opened a billing adjustment case. Victor wanted a credit before the next cycle.

Karen Whitfield asked about AT&T SD-WAN for two branch offices and wanted to understand security and performance benefits. Jennifer outlined the per-site model and booked a consultation with a solutions engineer. Karen agreed to review her current circuits before the call.

Sam Petrakis wanted a quote for SIP trunking to replace aging analog lines at his warehouse. Rose gathered his channel needs and scheduled a consultation with a voice specialist. Sam was interested but wanted pricing confirmed first.

Nadia Rahman complained that her International Day Pass charges appeared incorrect after returning from a trip. Oscar reviewed the daily rate applied and filed a dispute for review. Nadia was unhappy with the wait time on the line.

Greg Hollis called to cancel one of his wireless lines after an employee left the company. Lila processed the line removal and confirmed the prorated charge. Greg felt the process took longer than expected.

Dana Kirchner reported that her AT&T 5G Cell Booster Pro stopped providing in-building coverage. Lee ran diagnostics and started a warranty replacement request. Dana was frustrated about the office signal gaps in the meantime.

Paul Estrada called after hours about a Dedicated Internet outage affecting his office and reached voicemail. He left a message asking for an urgent callback and his SLA reference number. No agent was available to take the call.

Lorraine Byrd called to cancel her Business Fiber service after repeated slowdowns at her clinic. Mary tried to retain the account but Lorraine insisted on ending service. The call ended with a cancellation request submitted.

Curtis Nolan was angry about a large unexpected balance on his Business Unlimited account and demanded a full explanation. Mike reviewed the charges but Curtis grew more upset about prior promises. The billing dispute was escalated to a supervisor.

prompts.question: Is the customer trying to solve a specific problem?
prompts.answer: Yes. The caller's small business is experiencing slow internet speeds and needs to upgrade from their current DSL service to a faster option to support their growing team of eight employees.

prompts.question: What are the customer's expectations?
prompts.answer: The customer expects a quick consultation to understand pricing for AT&T Business Fiber or Wireless Internet options, with a technician visit to assess their location and provide a formal quote within one week.

prompts.question: How could the agent handle the call better?
prompts.answer: The agent should have captured the customer's email address for sending appointment confirmation and product information. Additionally, setting clear expectations about what the technician will evaluate during the site visit would have increased customer confidence and reduced cancellations.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Good afternoon, thank you for calling AT&T Business Sales. This is Marcus speaking. May I have your name please?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hi Marcus. My name is Jennifer Sanchez. I own a small marketing agency here in Chicago.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Jennifer, it's great to hear from you today. I appreciate you choosing AT&T Business. Can you tell me a bit about your business? How many employees do you have at your location?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: We have eight full time employees, and we're starting to see issues with our current internet speed. It's just not keeping up anymore.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I completely understand. Internet speed is critical for a marketing team. We have some excellent options that could solve that. What kind of speeds are you currently getting with your provider?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: I think it's around 25 megabits down, but it feels much slower when everyone's on video calls and uploading files.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Yes, 25 megabits won't cut it for eight people collaborating. We can get you up to 1 gigabit with our Business Fiber service, or if fiber isn't available in your area, we have a fantastic 5G Wireless Internet option starting at $60 per month. Can you provide me with your ZIP code so I can check availability?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Sure. It's 60611.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Perfect. 60611 in Chicago. Let me note your business address as well for the technician visit. Is it the same as 2847 North Clybourn Avenue?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Yes, that's right. That's our office location.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Excellent. Jennifer, I'd like to schedule a no-cost site visit where our technician can assess your current setup and confirm exact speeds and pricing we can offer you. We have availability this Thursday at 2 PM or Friday at 10 AM. Which works better for you?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Friday at 10 AM is perfect. That gives me time to let the team know.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Great choice. So your appointment is confirmed for Friday, October 25th at 10 AM at 2847 North Clybourn Avenue in Chicago. Your reference number is 0597-627F62F2570D. The technician will bring equipment to test your connection speeds and discuss options for AT&T Business Fiber and our wireless solutions. Is there anything else I can help you with today?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: No, I think that covers it. Thank you so much, Marcus.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're very welcome, Jennifer. We look forward to helping your team get faster, more reliable internet. Have a great day.

callDetail.aiSummary: Jennifer Sanchez, owner of an eight-person marketing agency in Chicago's 60611 ZIP code, called to upgrade from her current 25 Mbps DSL service due to performance issues affecting video conferencing and file uploads. Marcus Bell qualified the customer on business type and location, confirmed service availability, and positioned both AT&T Business Fiber and Wireless Internet solutions before scheduling a no-cost site visit for Friday, October 25th at 10 AM. Although the appointment was successfully booked with a reference number and clear confirmation, the agent did not capture Jennifer's email address for follow-up materials or set detailed expectations about the technician's evaluation process.

comment.author: Kyle Paklaian
comment.text: @Marcus, excellent job structuring this intake call. You opened strong, qualified Jennifer on business size and current pain point, confirmed the service area, and closed with a specific appointment time and reference number. Two quick coaching notes for next time: ask for email address before hanging up so you can send the appointment confirmation and product comparison sheets automatically. Also, take 15 seconds at the end to walk her through what to expect during the site visit, so she's not surprised when the tech arrives with test equipment. Those two touches will reduce no-shows and increase confidence in our process.

Qualify one question at a time: I'll ask a few quick questions one at a time, how many wireless lines or business locations you need, which solution fits best (Business Unlimited wireless, Business Fiber, VoIP, SD-WAN, or cybersecurity), your current provider and rough monthly spend, your ideal install or activation timeline, and finally your business ZIP code so I can confirm availability at your address.

Estimate then book: Once I confirm we service your ZIP, I'll share a preliminary monthly price range based on what you told me, then recommend a consultation with a Business Solutions specialist for an exact quote. I'll propose a specific day and time, and you'll get a reminder text before the appointment with a number to call.

qaPairs.question: How much is the AT&T Business Unlimited Advanced plan?
qaPairs.answer: Business Unlimited Advanced starts around $25 per line per month with four lines and includes 100GB of hotspot data on each line. Pricing depends on line count and current promotions, so let's book a consultation to lock in your exact rate.

qaPairs.question: What is the difference between the Business Unlimited plans?
qaPairs.answer: The main differences are hotspot data and international features, ranging from Standard up to Ultimate with unlimited hotspot. A specialist can match the right tier to how your team works, want me to set that up?

qaPairs.question: How many lines do I need to qualify for the 4-line pricing?
qaPairs.answer: The best per line pricing shows with four qualifying lines on AutoPay and paperless billing. I can have a specialist confirm the total for your line count on a quick consultation.

qaPairs.question: Do you offer business fiber internet?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, AT&T Business Fiber offers high speed symmetrical internet with unlimited data, starting around $40 per month. Let's schedule a consultation to confirm fiber availability at your address.

qaPairs.question: Is AT&T Business Fiber available at my location?
qaPairs.answer: Availability varies by address, so I'd want to verify your service ZIP before quoting. Share your ZIP and I'll get you booked with a specialist to confirm.

qaPairs.question: What internet options do you have if fiber isn't available?
qaPairs.answer: We also offer Wireless Internet fixed 5G with no caps or contracts and Dedicated Internet with guaranteed SLAs. A specialist can recommend the best fit on a consultation.

qaPairs.question: How fast is AT&T Dedicated Internet?
qaPairs.answer: Dedicated Internet provides secure, dedicated bandwidth up to 1Tbps with guaranteed service level agreements. Pricing scales with bandwidth, so let's book a consultation for an exact quote.

qaPairs.question: Can I switch to AT&T Business and keep my phone numbers?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, we can port your existing business numbers when you switch, and you may save up to $800 per line to break your current contract. Let me set up a consultation to get started.

qaPairs.question: What is the current switch offer?
qaPairs.answer: Right now qualifying businesses can save up to $800 per line to switch and earn a $500 reward card. A specialist can confirm which offers apply to you on a quick consultation.

qaPairs.question: Do you have a VoIP or business phone system?
qaPairs.answer: AT&T Phone for Business is a VoIP business line with unlimited nationwide calling and advanced calling features. Let's schedule a consultation to size the right solution for your team.

qaPairs.question: What is SIP trunking and do you offer it?
qaPairs.answer: IP Flexible Reach is our scalable SIP trunking that connects your IP-PBX to the phone network, priced per channel. A specialist can scope your channel needs on a consultation.

qaPairs.question: Can you help with cybersecurity for my business network?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, we offer Managed SASE for AI accelerated security and Dynamic Defense that stops threats at the network edge. These are custom quoted, so let's book a consultation to scope your environment.

qaPairs.question: What is SD-WAN and how much does it cost?
qaPairs.answer: AT&T SD-WAN optimizes your network with enhanced performance, security, and intelligence, typically priced per site. A specialist can give you an exact per site quote on a consultation.

qaPairs.question: Do you offer private cellular networks?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, our Private Cellular Networks deliver dedicated on premise 5G or LTE combining connectivity, control, and compute. Pricing is custom, so let's set up a consultation with an enterprise specialist.

qaPairs.question: Can I improve weak cell signal in my office?
qaPairs.answer: The AT&T 5G Cell Booster Pro provides in building cellular coverage for weak signal locations. A specialist can confirm the right in building solution on a consultation.

qaPairs.question: Do you have plans for international travel?
qaPairs.answer: The International Day Pass for Business lets your team use their domestic plan abroad with promotional daily pricing. Let's book a consultation to add it to the right lines.

qaPairs.question: Can I get IoT connectivity for my devices?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, we offer IoT connectivity and solutions to manage connected devices at scale. A specialist can tailor a plan to your device count on a consultation.

qaPairs.question: How do I add more lines to my current account?
qaPairs.answer: We can add lines and keep your team on a consistent plan and rate. Let me connect you with a specialist to review options on a quick consultation.

qaPairs.question: Do you offer discounts for AutoPay?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, enrolling in AutoPay and paperless billing can lower your monthly per line rate. A specialist can confirm your savings when we book your consultation.

qaPairs.question: How do I get an exact quote for my business?
qaPairs.answer: The best way is a short consultation with a Business Solutions specialist who can price your exact setup. Share your ZIP and preferred time and I'll get you scheduled.
